description: Create a new Colab notebook (ltx_director_mv_colab.ipynb.txt) that wraps the LTX 2.3 Director 2.0 MV Workflow into a beginner-friendly single-click interface. The notebook must: (1) convert the complex graph-format workflow into API format embedded directly in the notebook code, (2) set up ComfyUI with all required custom nodes and models, (3) provide a music video generation cell with user-configurable parameters that uploads reference images + audio, builds the API-format workflow with LTXDirector timeline data, submits to ComfyUI, and displays the output MP4.
steps: Create the file /projects/sandbox/Ai/ltx_director_mv_colab.ipynb.txt as a valid Jupyter Notebook JSON (.ipynb format saved as .txt) following the exact structure of ltx_video_generator_colab.ipynb.txt

Cell 1 (Markdown): Header with title 'LTX Director 2.0 - Music Video Generator', description mentioning 31.5s 1280x720 24fps output, two-stage sampling pipeline, LTXDirector timeline control, same social/badge links as original notebook

Cell 2 (Code - Setup): Install dependencies (same pip packages as original plus any extras). Git clone ComfyUI and these custom nodes: ComfyUI-KJNodes, ComfyUI-GGUF, ComfyUI-LTXVideo, ComfyUI-VideoHelperSuite, ComfyUI-MelBandRoFormer, rgthree-comfy (https://github.com/rgthree/rgthree-comfy), whatdreamscost-comfyui (https://github.com/whatdreamscost/whatdreamscost-comfyui). Download models via aria2c: (a) ltx-2-3-22b-dev-Q4_K_M.gguf to models/unet, (b) gemma_3_12B_it_fp4_mixed.safetensors to models/text_encoders (from https://huggingface.co/SeanScripts/gemma-3-12b-it-qat-q4_0-gguf/resolve/main/gemma_3_12B_it_fp4_mixed.safetensors), (c) ltx-2.3_text_projection_bf16.safetensors to models/text_encoders (from https://huggingface.co/Lightricks/LTX-2.3/resolve/main/ltx-2.3_text_projection_bf16.safetensors), (d) LTX23_video_vae_bf16.safetensors to models/vae (from https://huggingface.co/Kijai/LTX2.3_comfy/resolve/main/vae/LTX23_video_vae_bf16.safetensors), (e) LTX23_audio_vae_bf16.safetensors to models/vae (from https://huggingface.co/Kijai/LTX2.3_comfy/resolve/main/vae/LTX23_audio_vae_bf16.safetensors), (f) taeltx2_3.safetensors to models/vae (from https://huggingface.co/Kijai/LTX2.3_comfy/resolve/main/vae/taeltx2_3.safetensors), (g) ltx-2.3-spatial-upscaler-x2-1.1.safetensors to models/latent_upscale_models (from https://huggingface.co/Lightricks/LTX-2.3/resolve/main/ltx-2.3-spatial-upscaler-x2-1.1.safetensors), (h) ltx-2.3-22b-distilled-lora-dynamic_fro09_avg_rank_105_bf16.safetensors to models/loras (from https://huggingface.co/Lightricks/LTX-2.3/resolve/main/ltx-2.3-22b-distilled-lora-dynamic_fro09_avg_rank_105_bf16.safetensors), (i) LTX-2.3-OmniNFT-RL-Lora_bf16.safetensors to models/loras (from https://huggingface.co/Kijai/LTX2.3_comfy/resolve/main/loras/LTX-2.3-OmniNFT-RL-Lora_bf16.safetensors), (j) ltx2.3-transition.safetensors to models/loras (from https://huggingface.co/Kijai/LTX2.3_comfy/resolve/main/loras/ltx2.3-transition.safetensors), (k) LTX2.3-MVCamera-drclips.safetensors to models/loras (from https://huggingface.co/Kijai/LTX2.3_comfy/resolve/main/loras/LTX2.3-MVCamera-drclips.safetensors), (l) MelBandRoformer_fp16.safetensors to models/diffusion_models

Cell 3 (Code - Music Video Generation): This is the main generation cell. It should have Colab form parameters (@param) for: global_prompt (string, with a good default music video prompt), video_duration_seconds (slider 4-31.5, default 31.5), video_width (int, default 1280), video_height (int, default 720), frame_rate (int, default 24), noise_seed (int, default 0), stage1_steps (int, default 8), stage1_denoise (float, default 1.0), stage2_steps (int, default 4), stage2_denoise (float, default 0.42), distilled_lora_strength (float, default 0.4), omnift_lora_strength (float, default 0.6), transition_lora_strength (float, default 0.7), mvcamera_lora_strength (float, default 0.9). The cell must: (a) prompt user to upload reference images (1-5 PNG/JPG files) via google.colab files.upload(), (b) prompt user to upload an audio file (MP3), (c) copy uploaded files to /content/ComfyUI/input/whatdreamscost/ subfolder, (d) boot ComfyUI server if not running, (e) build the API-format workflow dict programmatically in Python (NOT fetched from URL), constructing all nodes with correct class_types and wiring based on the Director 2.0 workflow analysis below, (f) POST to /prompt endpoint, (g) poll /history until complete, (h) display the output MP4

The API-format workflow must be constructed in Python code as a dict, implementing these nodes (using string IDs): Node '8' VAELoader (LTX23_audio_vae_bf16.safetensors), Node '36' VAELoader (LTX23_video_vae_bf16.safetensors), Node '6' VAELoaderKJ (taeltx2_3.safetensors, main_device, bf16), Node '135' UnetLoaderGGUF (ltx-2-3-22b-dev-Q4_K_M.gguf), Node '12' DualCLIPLoader (gemma_3_12B_it_fp4_mixed.safetensors, ltx-2.3_text_projection_bf16.safetensors, ltxv, default), Node '138' Power Lora Loader (rgthree) with 4 LoRAs and strengths, Node '10' ModelPreviewOverrideKJ, Node '131' LTXDirector (the central node with global_prompt, timeline_data, frame_rate, dimensions, duration, segments, audio), Node '128' ConditioningZeroOut, Node '27' LTXVConditioning (frame_rate=24), Node '133' LTXDirectorGuide (Stage 1 - guide_strength 0.5), Node '29' LTXVConcatAVLatent (Stage 1), Node '28' CFGGuider (cfg=1, Stage 1), Node '32' KSamplerSelect (euler, Stage 1), Node '33' BasicScheduler (linear_quadratic, 8 steps, denoise 1.0, Stage 1), Node '31' SamplerCustomAdvanced (Stage 1), Node '34' LTXVSeparateAVLatent (Stage 1 output), Node '55' LTXDirectorCropGuides (post Stage 1), Node '14' LTXVLatentUpsampler, Node '13' LatentUpscaleModelLoader (ltx-2.3-spatial-upscaler-x2-1.1.safetensors), Node '132' LTXDirectorGuide (Stage 2 - guide_strength 1.0), Node '18' LTXVConcatAVLatent (Stage 2), Node '17' CFGGuider (cfg=1, Stage 2), Node '20' KSamplerSelect (euler, Stage 2), Node '21' BasicScheduler (linear_quadratic, 4 steps, denoise 0.42, Stage 2), Node '19' SamplerCustomAdvanced (Stage 2), Node '22' LTXVSeparateAVLatent (Stage 2 output), Node '54' LTXDirectorCropGuides (post Stage 2), Node '30' RandomNoise (seed), Node '1' VAEDecode (video), Node '24' LTXVAudioVAEDecode, Node '139' VHS_VideoCombine (h264-mp4, crf 8, 24fps). All node connections must follow the links array from the graph-format workflow.

The LTXDirector node (131) properties must include: global_prompt (from user param), timeline_data JSON string containing segments array (built dynamically from uploaded images with evenly distributed lengths across total frames), audioSegments array (built from uploaded audio with trimStart=0), frame_rate, custom_width, custom_height, duration_seconds, start_second=0, end_second=duration, inpaint_audio=true, mainTrackEnabled=true, audioTrackEnabled=true, motionTrackEnabled=true. The widget_values for LTXDirector must match the expected format.
Cell 4 (Markdown): Footer with social links, same as original notebook
Ensure the output file is valid JSON that parses as a Jupyter notebook (nbformat 4, nbformat_minor 0, proper metadata with colab provenance)
acceptance_criteria: The file /projects/sandbox/Ai/ltx_director_mv_colab.ipynb.txt exists and is valid JSON
The JSON parses as a valid Jupyter notebook with nbformat=4
The notebook has at least 4 cells (header markdown, setup code, generation code, footer markdown)
The setup cell downloads all required models (GGUF model, text encoders, VAEs, upscaler, 4 LoRAs, MelBandRoformer)
The setup cell clones all required custom nodes including whatdreamscost-comfyui and rgthree-comfy
The generation cell builds the full API-format workflow programmatically with all nodes from the Director 2.0 workflow
The generation cell includes proper LTXDirector timeline_data construction from uploaded images and audio
The generation cell has @param form fields for prompt, duration, dimensions, seeds, LoRA strengths
The workflow implements the two-stage pipeline: Stage 1 (8 steps, denoise 1.0) -> Upscale -> Stage 2 (4 steps, denoise 0.42)
Running python -c "import json; json.load(open('ltx_director_mv_colab.ipynb.txt'))" succeeds without error
verification: Run: python -c "import json; nb=json.load(open('/projects/sandbox/Ai/ltx_director_mv_colab.ipynb.txt')); assert nb['nbformat']==4; print('Valid notebook'); cells=nb['cells']; print(f'{len(cells)} cells'); code_cells=[c for c in cells if c['cell_type']=='code']; print(f'{len(code_cells)} code cells'); src=''.join(code_cells[1]['source']); assert 'LTXDirector' in src; assert 'whatdreamscost' in src; assert 'VHS_VideoCombine' in src; print('All key nodes present')"

Run: python -c "import json; nb=json.load(open('/projects/sandbox/Ai/ltx_director_mv_colab.ipynb.txt')); code_cells=[c for c in nb['cells'] if c['cell_type']=='code']; setup=''.join(code_cells[0]['source']); assert 'ltx-2-3-22b-dev-Q4_K_M.gguf' in setup; assert 'whatdreamscost-comfyui' in setup; assert 'rgthree-comfy' in setup; assert 'distilled-lora-dynamic' in setup or 'distilled_lora_dynamic' in setup; print('Setup cell has all models and nodes')"
findings: All verification checks pass. The notebook is valid JSON (nbformat 4), has 4 cells (2 markdown, 2 code), and the generation cell includes all 25+ nodes from the Director 2.0 workflow correctly wired in API format. The setup cell downloads all required models and clones all 7 custom node repos including whatdreamscost-comfyui and rgthree-comfy. Python 3 is available via python3 command (not python) in this environment. Review fixes applied: (1) header updated to recommend A100/L4 with T4 warning, --lowvram flag added to server launch; (2) 30-minute timeout + server crash detection added to poll loop; (3) MelBandRoFormer path verified correct (matches original notebook, whatdreamscost-comfyui handles resolution); (4) Content-Type: application/json header added to /prompt request.
